text: {"executive_summary": "The Motor TPL claim frequency GLM is rated amber overall: performance and stability are green, while calibration and fairness are amber. On the held-out test set the model predicts [[performance.test_expected_claims]] claims against [[performance.test_actual_claims]] observed, an overall A/E of [[performance.ae_overall]], and the test-to-train deviance ratio of [[performance.deviance_ratio_test_train]] shows no sign of overfitting. The amber ratings arise from localised miscalibration in the worst predicted-frequency decile (deviation [[calibration.worst_decile_ae_dev]]) and in the worst driver age band (deviation [[fairness.worst_driver_age_ae_dev]]), both inside the amber tolerance but outside green. There are also documentation gaps: LogDensity is used but undocumented, and Density is documented but not in the fitted model. Remediation should focus on recalibration review and on correcting the documentation before the model is relied on for high-tier use.", "sections": {"performance": "Overall calibration-in-the-large is good: actual claims of [[performance.test_actual_claims]] compare with [[performance.test_expected_claims]] expected, giving an A/E of [[performance.ae_overall]] and a deviation of [[performance.ae_dev]], rated green. The test mean Poisson deviance of [[performance.test_mean_poisson_deviance]] is close to the training value of [[performance.train_mean_poisson_deviance]] (ratio [[performance.deviance_ratio_test_train]]), indicating the fit generalises. The test Lorenz Gini of [[performance.test_lorenz_gini]] is reported for information only, as no agreed threshold exists for this portfolio, so discriminatory power is not formally rated.", "calibration": "Aggregate accuracy masks some unevenness across the risk distribution: the worst predicted-frequency decile deviates from A/E of 1 by [[calibration.worst_decile_ae_dev]], which is amber. By contrast, the worst Area segment ([[calibration.worst_Area_ae_dev]]) and worst VehGas segment ([[calibration.worst_VehGas_ae_dev]]) are green, so the issue appears tied to the prediction ranking rather than to these rating factors. Decile-level miscalibration matters because it implies systematic mispricing of the lowest- or highest-risk policies even when the portfolio total balances.", "stability": "Input stability between the training and test samples is strong, with the largest feature PSI of [[stability.max_feature_psi]] (feature Region) far below the amber threshold, rated green. This is expected for a random split and gives limited evidence about drift in live business. Score PSI could not be assessed because the legacy code does not retain development-sample predictions.", "fairness": "A/E by driver age band shows a worst deviation of [[fairness.worst_driver_age_ae_dev]], which is amber, indicating that at least one age band is somewhat over- or under-priced relative to observed claims. Because driver age is a rating factor, this test is the evidence that age-based pricing is supported by reliable data. Sex is not in the data, so no gender analysis was possible, and whether the use of age is permissible is a legal and conduct question for the reviewer rather than a statistical one."}, "findings": [{"severity": "medium", "section": "calibration", "finding": "The worst predicted-frequency decile has an A/E deviation of [[calibration.worst_decile_ae_dev]], outside the green tolerance, although overall A/E is [[performance.ae_overall]]. Predictions are therefore not uniformly calibrated across the risk range.", "recommendation": "Identify which decile is affected and whether the bias is over- or under-prediction, and test whether recalibration or a revised functional form removes it. Monitor decile A/E in ongoing monitoring with an agreed trigger."}, {"severity": "medium", "section": "fairness", "finding": "At least one driver age band shows an A/E deviation of [[fairness.worst_driver_age_ae_dev]], suggesting that age band is systematically mispriced relative to experience.", "recommendation": "Review age-band A/E in detail, assess whether the age effect specification (for example banding or non-linearity) needs refinement, and refer the permissibility of using age as a rating factor to the legal and conduct reviewer."}, {"severity": "low", "section": "performance", "finding": "Documentation does not match the fitted model: LogDensity is used but undocumented, while Density is documented as an input but is not in the fitted model.", "recommendation": "Update the model documentation to describe the LogDensity transformation and remove or correct the reference to Density, with owner sign-off."}], "limitations": ["Score PSI was not assessed because the legacy code does not keep development-sample predictions.", "The Lorenz Gini and deviance ratio are reported without a rating because no agreed threshold exists for this portfolio.", "Validation uses a random split of freMTPL2 data, so out-of-time performance and drift on current live business were not assessed.", "Sex is not in the data, so no gender-based fairness analysis was possible; the lawfulness of using driver age is a legal and conduct matter outside this statistical validation.", "Calibration segment checks cover only Area and VehGas, with segments restricted to those with sufficient exposure."]}
